title: The town mouse and the country mouse.
lines: In the countryside, among the cornfields, lives a little country mouse.
She lives in a little hole under a tree.
A table made from a mushroom.
She eats seeds, grains and berries.
The country mouse has a cousin.
He lives in the big city.
He wears a smart jacket and a bow tie.
One day the town mouse comes to visit.
How quiet it is where you live.
She puts all her best food on the table.
The town mouse pulls a face.
Do you eat seeds every day?
Come with me to the city.
They ride on a cart full of vegetables.
They arrive in the big city.
The town mouse lives in a big house.
In a hole in the dining room wall.
There's a big feast on the table.
The country mouse can't believe her eyes.
There are biscuits and grapes and sausages.
The country mouse takes a bite of cheese.
The mice run to the hole in the wall.
The country mouse is shaking all over.
After a while the cat goes away.
They climb back onto the table.
The country mouse takes a piece of cake.
Then the cook comes in with a broom.
Again the mice run to the hole.
The country mouse is completely out of breath.
Then two dogs come in as well.
They bark and sniff at the hole.
The country mouse puts on her little hat.
But we haven't tasted everything yet!
I'd rather eat a seed every day in peace, says the country mouse.
The country mouse goes back to her little hole.
She lies in her mossy bed.
